newsitem.title: USA: Forcenergy files stock offer. [CORRECTED 16:43 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Forcenergy files stock offer. [CORRECTED 16:43 GMT]

text.p: Forcenergy Inc said on Tuesday it had filed with the Securities and Exchange to offer up to 3.5 million common shares.

The Miami-based company said it is selling 1,537,958 shares, while 1,962,042 are being offered by shareholders. The underwriters have been granted an over-allotment option on up to 525,000 additional shares.
Concurrently with the stock offer, the company is offering $175 million in senior subordinated notes due 2006, the filing said.
The offering will be made through Goldman Sachs & Co, Donaldson Lufkin & Jenrette Securities Corp, Howard, Weil, Labouisse Friedrichs Inc and Prudential Securites Inc.

Proceeds will be used to repay a portion of the company's debt under its senior credit facility. The company may reborrow amounts under the facility to fund its continuing capital expenditure program and other general corporate purposes. (Correction deletes reference to National Data)
